title: Parallel paper lookup protocol
description: Updates literature-search guidance so specific-paper requests use academic lookup and native websearch/webfetch in parallel before asking the user for more clues.
changes: Rename Paper Lookup first to Parallel Paper Lookup first.
Require arc_lookup_paper with the original phrase and native websearch with focused query variants.
Require webfetch verification of trusted paper pages.
Forbid listing candidates that only match versions, years, numbers, or generic words.
Ask the user for more clues only after both academic and web lookup fail.

rollback.notes: Restore the prior Paper Lookup first skill version.
